title: IncrementalClassificationNaiveBayes Predict
text: Classify observations using incremental naive Bayes classification model, 2 inputs, 4 outputs, direct feedthrough, {Estimated cost data type} sets Data type of cost output Inherit:; {Select initial machine learning model} sets the initial incremental naive Bayes classification model, {Add output port for predicted class scores}, {Add output port for expected classification cost} adds optional output port for expected classification, {Add output port for status of trained machine learning model} adds second output port for model status, {Sample time (–1 for inherited)} sets the option to specify sample, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the prevention of fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Label data type} sets the data type of label output, {Label data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of label output for range checking, {Label data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of label output for range checking, {Score data type} sets the data type of score output Inherit, {Score data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of score output for range checking, {Score data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of score output for range checking, {Raw score data type} sets the untransformed score data type Inherit, {Raw score data type Minimum} sets the minimum untransformed score for range checking, {Raw score data type Maximum} sets the maximum untransformed score for range checking, {Estimated cost data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of cost output for range checking, {Estimated cost data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of cost output for range checking, {Likelihood data type} sets the data type of likelihood output Inherit, {Likelihood data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of likelihood output for range checking, {Likelihood data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of likelihood output for range checking, {Posterior data type} sets the data type of posterior probability output, {Posterior data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of posterior probability output for range checking and {Posterior data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of posterior probability output for range checking. Values come from the instance.
